scope: Public upstream authored merged PRs; owned repositories and Genesis-Embodied-AI excluded. Global totals include repositories below the homepage's strict >1,000-star display threshold. Four unavailable ONNX Runtime identities retain historical evidence.

search_verification.method: Fresh complete identity enumeration of public authored upstream merged PRs using four disjoint creation-date ranges, each below the 1,000-result cap. All 21 pages were collected; totals stayed stable across each partition. The 1,793 search identities plus three individually rechecked known search omissions yield 1,796 accessible merged PRs. Every one of the 65 new identities was individually checked via its pull-request endpoint for Afloat16 authorship, actual merged state and merge SHA. Four historical unavailable ONNX Runtime identities are retained.
search_verification.search_merge_sha_note: Search responses contain merged timestamps but not merge SHAs. Fresh direct checks include the merge SHA. Older unchanged SHA provenance remains in the pinned baseline receipts.
